SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: Measured against pathways[17] and the LD-OK-01 contract. 'When to stop and get help' (instructions and page 5) carries: an adult arrest, charge, indictment or information pending (an express statutory bar); costs, restitution, fines or ordered requirements outstanding; the case not dismissed or closed; a wish for destruction rather than sealing (the profile: 'records are not physically destroyed by default'); and any immigration question. The contract's conditions (current law effective July 1, 2026; excluded offenses and clean-record rules apply) are printed on the petition and in the instructions.
